messages.subject: Error: unexpected symbol in model
parts:
Hi everybody,

For any reason, I can't read in the following model. I always get the error: "
Error: unexpected symbol in "2tier.model"

Similar models (with fewer items) work and I was unable to detect the problem so far. Does anybody have an idea what could be the problem?

best,
Michael

2tier.model <- '

INT =~ INTas1 + INTas2  + INTas3  + INTas4  + INTas5  + INTas6  + INTas7  + INTas8    + INTas9    + INTas10    + INTas11    + INTas12    + INTas13    + INTas14    + INTas15 + INTan1 + INTan2  + INTan3  + INTan4  + INTan5  + INTan6  + INTan7  + INTan8  + INTan9  + INTan10  + INTan11    + INTan12    + INTan13    + INTan14    + INTan15

ASS ~~ ANT
BIAS ~ ASS + ANT + PHY + DOM + INT'
